title: THIS dot is the null axis of green. its ORIGIN. as a LASER.

do_not_reinvent.hole: /data/green-removed-null-axis.json  green is the hole. not a costume fill.
do_not_reinvent.pan: /data/hud-null-d-pan.json  the nameplate. we called the lime ice. now it is named as the laser origin.
do_not_reinvent.radiate: /data/color-null-radiate.json  all colors leave A. this is green's leaving, as a beam.
do_not_reinvent.range: /data/orbit-color-tope-green.json  tope-sort the far INTO this hole. the laser is the origin of that aim.
do_not_reinvent.line: /data/localize-lines.json  a laser is a local line. it does not flood the glass.

this_shot.dot: the lime point on HUD. the nameplate grain.
this_shot.is: the null axis of green. ORIGIN. a LASER. one coherent point.

laser.yes: a beam. origin here. out from the hole. not a fill. not a 100 bar.
laser.not: paint the HUD green. not bring the costume axis back. the rest of the glass stays pale of green.

law: one green origin as laser. if the beam becomes a flood we failed the hole. if we scrape the dot off we lost the origin.
pull: keep the point. let it lase. do not spread it. tope-sort still aims the far at this hole.
